name: speusis-update-dialog
description: Standalone React source for the auto-update dialog's separate native window. Builds to a single self-contained HTML file at dist/renderer/update-dialog/index.html, which src-tauri/src/commands.rs points the autoUpdateDialog native window at instead of index.html?panel=autoUpdateDialog. Uses the app's real window.__TAURI__ global (withGlobalTauri) and links the shared dist/renderer/styles.css at runtime, so it always matches the app's current theme/accent with zero duplicated CSS.
